read.thesis: Nutrien's potash and nitrogen volumes are guided up with capex trimmed to $1.95-2.00B, while phosphate is being shut (White Springs) after Aurora bids were rejected; Q3 retail EBITDA was $203M and cut guidance was flagged.

utilisation.quote: Through operational and excellence initiatives, we have increased operating rates at Aurora from 80% in 2024 to 85% over the past 12 months.

capex.quote: we brought down the top end of CapEx guidance this year

triggers.label: White Springs shutdown Q2 2027
triggers.quote: shutting down operations at our White Springs facility in the second quarter of 2027

triggers.label: Capex guidance trimmed to $1.95-2.00B
triggers.quote: we brought down the top end of CapEx guidance this year

triggers.label: Higher-cost N inventory cleared channel
triggers.quote: the higher level of sell-through of some of that higher-cost nitrogen inventory, which has now cleared our channel

triggers.label: Phosphate volume guide lowered
triggers.quote: Phosphate Sales Guidance -- 2.40 million to 2.55 million tons, lowered due to deferred customer demand and operational constraints.

triggers.label: Retail EBITDA guide cut to $1.72-1.85B
triggers.quote: We've revised our full-year retail adjusted EBITDA guidance range to $1.72 billion-$1.85 billion

guidance.quote: We raised our full-year potash sales volume guidance range to 14.3 million-14.8 million tons
we have increased our full-year nitrogen sales volume guidance range to 9.3 million-9.7 million tons
Phosphate Sales Guidance -- 2.40 million to 2.55 million tons, lowered due to deferred customer demand and operational constraints.
We've revised our full-year retail adjusted EBITDA guidance range to $1.72 billion-$1.85 billion
we brought down the top end of CapEx guidance this year
Effective Tax Rate Guidance -- 25.5% to 27.0%, increased due to a shift in the geographic earnings mix.
we expect ammonia operating rates above 95% in the fourth quarter
